extra: Life with Fire already has four hand-written fusions the owner called phenomenal: Cauterize Wounds (sacrifice health, burn yourself, dispel, Healing Balm per effect), Searing Renewal (a fire bolt whose Burning heals you), Hearthfire (a fire field that heals allies and burns enemies), Rekindle (below 30% health you burst into flame and regain health). Write FOUR MORE, each a different life-and-fire idea from those four and from each other, at the same level.
